subproblems.title: η_{x,λ#} commutes with differences and boundaries, is injective, and maps supports by η
subproblems.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, η = η_{x,λ} and η_# = η_{x,λ#} (blowUp · x λ). Then (i) η_#(S − T) = η_#S − η_#T for all n and S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U); (ii) η_#S = η_#T implies S = T for all n and S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U); (iii) spt(η_#T) = η(spt T) for all n and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), where for a current Y with domain V, spt Y = V ∖ ⋃{W : W open, closure W compact, closure W ⊆ V, Y(ω) = 0 for all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W} (SimonGMT support); (iv) ∂(η_#T) = η_#(∂T) for all m and T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ (n : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), blowUp (S - T) x lam hlam.ne' = blowUp S x lam hlam.ne' - blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), blowUp S x lam hlam.ne' = blowUp T x lam hlam.ne' → S = T) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').support = dilation x lam '' T.support) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').boundary = blowUp T.boundary x lam hlam.ne'

- Use. Only (iii) is consumed: (Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra P U x σ hσ).2.2.1 n T gives spt(blowUp T x σ) = dilation x σ '' spt T.
- Cited prerequisite. 'testform_correspondence' in the proof below is the comparator-accepted Submission.dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr. It is node root.density_and_tangent_cones-a1.blowup_scaling-a1.testform_correspondence-a1 (candidate commit 5e184fbc2dc0f26dbd9ce6b79feabd198b8ba518) and is present at line 461 of the Submission.lean of f64597f. For λ > 0 and η = dilation x λ it states:
 (a) every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)) has some ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for all y;
 (b) every ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) has some ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for all y;
 (c) for T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and any such pair, η_{x,λ#}T(ω) = λ^{−n}·T(ω').
- Source of the proof. The numbered proof below is that node's independently reviewed parent-supplied proof, reproduced unchanged. Its 'parent proof', 'step' and sibling references are to that node's own parent and siblings.

Source: parent proof steps 3(c), 3(d); Simon Ch. 6, 2.23–2.24(1) (∂f_#T = f_#∂T, chapter-06.txt lines 405–418); support of a current (Simon 6.2.11; SimonGMT support, zeroRegion, VanishesOn).
Conventions. ℝ^P = Euclid P. For x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0, η := η_{x,λ} = dilation x λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − x), and ι(z) := x + λz. For V ⊆ ℝ^P (any subset), 𝒟ⁿ(V) = TestFormOn V n is the set of C^∞ maps ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (n-covectors) with compact topological support tsupport ω ⊆ V; elements of 𝒟ⁿ(V) are determined by their underlying forms. η_#Y := η_{x,λ#}Y = blowUp Y x λ for Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U). For Y ∈ 𝒟_n(V): Y vanishes on W iff Y(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W; Z(Y) := ⋃{W : W open, closure W compact, closure W ⊆ V, Y vanishes on W}; spt Y := V ∖ Z(Y). For Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)), η_#Y(ω) = Y(ν_ω), where ν_ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) is the affine pullback of ω by η (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P λ) (−λ⁻¹x) ω, regarded in U), which depends only on ω and not on Y. η is an affine homeomorphism of ℝ^P with inverse ι: η is y ↦ λ⁻¹y (a homeomorphism, λ⁻¹ ≠ 0) followed by the translation z ↦ z − λ⁻¹x, η(ι(z)) = λ⁻¹(x + λz − x) = z and ι(η(y)) = x + λ·λ⁻¹(y − x) = y; in particular η is injective, η⁻¹(η(E)) = E, and for continuous h and any f, tsupport(f∘h) ⊆ h⁻¹(tsupport f) (the closed set h⁻¹(tsupport f) contains {f∘h ≠ 0}).
1. (i) For ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)): η_#(S − T)(ω) = (S − T)(ν_ω) = S(ν_ω) − T(ν_ω) = η_#S(ω) − η_#T(ω), because S − T is the pointwise difference of the underlying linear functionals. Currents that agree on every test form are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext).
2. (ii) Suppose η_#S = η_#T and let ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). By testform_correspondence (b) choose ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for all y. By testform_correspondence (c), λ^{−n}S(ω') = η_#S(ω) = η_#T(ω) = λ^{−n}T(ω'). Since λ^{−n} ≠ 0, S(ω') = T(ω'). Hence S = T.
3. (iii) Claim: Z(η_#T) = η(Z(T)).
 (⊆) Let z ∈ W₀, where W₀ is open, closure W₀ is compact and ⊆ η(U), and η_#T vanishes on W₀. Put W := η⁻¹(W₀). W is open (η continuous). As η is a homeomorphism, closure W = η⁻¹(closure W₀), which is compact and contained in η⁻¹(η(U)) = U. T vanishes on W: let ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω' ⊆ W; by testform_correspondence (b) choose ω with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for all y; then ω = ω'∘ι (ω(z) = ω(η(ι(z))) = ω'(ι(z))), so tsupport ω ⊆ ι⁻¹(tsupport ω') ⊆ ι⁻¹(η⁻¹(W₀)) = W₀ (η∘ι = id); hence 0 = η_#T(ω) = λ^{−n}T(ω') by testform_correspondence (c), and T(ω') = 0. Thus W ⊆ Z(T); since η(ι(z)) = z ∈ W₀ we get ι(z) ∈ W ⊆ Z(T), and z = η(ι(z)) ∈ η(Z(T)).
 (⊇) Let z = η(w) with w ∈ W, where W is open, closure W is compact and ⊆ U, and T vanishes on W. Put W₀ := η(W). W₀ is open (a homeomorphism is an open map); closure W₀ = η(closure W) is compact (continuous image of a compact set) and contained in η(U). η_#T vanishes on W₀: let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(η(U)) with tsupport ω ⊆ W₀; by testform_correspondence (a) choose ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)); then tsupport ω' ⊆ η⁻¹(tsupport ω) ⊆ η⁻¹(η(W)) = W, so T(ω') = 0 and η_#T(ω) = λ^{−n}T(ω') = 0 by testform_correspondence (c). Hence z ∈ W₀ ⊆ Z(η_#T).
 Consequently spt(η_#T) = η(U) ∖ η(Z(T)) = η(U ∖ Z(T)) = η(spt T), the middle equality because η is injective.
4. (iv) Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^m(η(U)). By definition ∂Y(φ) = Y(dφ). Then ∂(η_#T)(ω) = η_#T(dω) = T(ν_{dω}) and η_#(∂T)(ω) = ∂T(ν_ω) = T(dν_ω), where the inclusion into 𝒟(U) does not change underlying forms. Exterior differentiation commutes with pullback by the affine map η: d(η^#ω) = η^#(dω) (SimonGMT exteriorDerivative_affinePullbackForm; this is the chain rule, η having constant derivative λ⁻¹·id). Hence dν_ω = ν_{dω}, the two values agree, and ∂(η_#T) = η_#(∂T) (equivalently, SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_affinePushforward applied to the restricted current, together with the fact that restricting the domain commutes with ∂). ∎
Formalization notes (this exact statement was proved in a scratch build from the sibling's exact type): (i) is `GeometricCurrentOn.ext fun ω => rfl`; (iv) is `unfold blowUp; rw [GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_affinePushforward]; rfl`; (ii) by GeometricCurrentOn.ext and mul_left_cancel₀; (iii) unfold GeometricCurrentOn.support, prove the zero-region identity by ext with Homeomorph.preimage_closure, Homeomorph.image_closure, Homeomorph.isCompact_preimage, Homeomorph.isOpenMap, IsCompact.image, tsupport_comp_subset_preimage, then rewrite with Set.image_sdiff (injectivity).
proof_key_steps: (i) Both sides evaluate S − T on the same pulled-back form.
(ii) Every test form in U is ω∘η for some ω (testform_correspondence (b)), and η_#Y(ω) = λ^{−n}Y(ω∘η) with λ^{−n} ≠ 0.
(iii) The zero regions correspond: η_#T vanishes on W₀ ⊂⊂ η(U) iff T vanishes on η⁻¹(W₀) ⊂⊂ U; hence Z(η_#T) = η(Z(T)) and spt(η_#T) = η(spt T) by injectivity.
(iv) d commutes with the affine pullback (exteriorDerivative_affinePullbackForm / boundary_affinePushforward).

subproblems.title: Dilation rescales slab flatness: η_{x,σ} maps a set β-flat at scale σ about x onto a set β-flat at scale 1 about 0
subproblems.statement: For all P ∈ ℕ, every set S ⊆ ℝ^P = Euclid P, every x ∈ ℝ^P, all reals σ > 0 and β, and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P (Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), with p_Q = Q.starProjection the orthogonal projection onto Q and η_{x,σ}(y) = σ⁻¹(y − x) (Contract dilation x σ, y ↦ −(σ⁻¹ • x) + σ⁻¹ • y): if |(y − x) − p_Q(y − x)| < β·σ for every y ∈ S with |y − x| < σ (dist y x < σ), then every u ∈ η_{x,σ}(S) (dilation x σ '' S) with |u| < 1 satisfies |u − p_Q(u)| < β.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (σ β : ℝ), 0 < σ → ∀ (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ S, dist y x < σ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * σ) → ∀ u ∈ dilation x σ '' S, ‖u‖ < 1 → ‖u - Q.starProjection u‖ < β
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source.
- This is steps 2–3 of the selected node's supplied proof (step 6 of the grandparent proof, supports of the blow-ups), with spt T replaced by an arbitrary set S.
- Step 1 there (u = η_{x,σ}(y) with y ∈ spt T) is here just the definition of membership in the image η_{x,σ}(S).
- Cf. Simon 7.3.3(2), relation (5), η_{x,λ}R_β(S) = R_β(η_{x,λ#}S), with h(spt S, L, ρ, x) from (3) (book/chapter-07.txt lines 512–531).

Notation.
- |·| = ‖·‖ is the Euclidean norm of ℝ^P = Euclid P, and dist(y, x) = |y − x|.
- η := η_{x,σ} = dilation x σ. By the Contract definitions, dilationCLM P σ = σ⁻¹ • id, so η(y) = −σ⁻¹x + σ⁻¹y.
- p := Q.starProjection : ℝ^P →L[ℝ] ℝ^P is the orthogonal projection onto Q. Its instance is Submodule.HasOrthogonalProjection.ofCompleteSpace, since Q is finite-dimensional and hence complete. Only the ℝ-linearity of p is used: p(c·v) = c·p(v).

Hypotheses: σ > 0, β ∈ ℝ (no sign assumption), and
 (H) |(y − x) − p(y − x)| < βσ for every y ∈ S with dist(y, x) < σ.
Claim: every u ∈ η(S) with |u| < 1 satisfies |u − p(u)| < β.

1. Let u ∈ η(S) with |u| < 1. By definition of the image, there is y ∈ S with u = η(y).
2. Since σ > 0, σ ≠ 0 and σσ⁻¹ = 1. Hence σu = σ(−σ⁻¹x + σ⁻¹y) = −(σσ⁻¹)x + (σσ⁻¹)y = −x + y = y − x.
3. Therefore dist(y, x) = |y − x| = |σu| = |σ|·|u| = σ|u|, as σ > 0. Since |u| < 1 and σ > 0, σ|u| < σ·1 = σ. So dist(y, x) < σ.
4. Since y ∈ S and dist(y, x) < σ, hypothesis (H) gives |(y − x) − p(y − x)| < βσ.
5. By step 2 and the linearity of p, (y − x) − p(y − x) = σu − p(σu) = σu − σp(u) = σ(u − p(u)). Hence |(y − x) − p(y − x)| = |σ|·|u − p(u)| = σ|u − p(u)|.
6. Combining steps 4 and 5, σ|u − p(u)| < βσ = σβ. Since σ ≥ 0, and a·b < a·c with a ≥ 0 implies b < c, we get |u − p(u)| < β. As u was an arbitrary point of η(S) with |u| < 1, the claim is proved. ∎
